A short but amazing indie title inspired by the likes of Contra and Metal Slug. But I must say, it is definitely better than them in every aspect. It's overall easier and more modern gamer friendly. The gameplay is pretty solid. The cyberpunk art design is top-notch and overall, it does a brilliant job at giving that retro vibe in every corner. Even the character lines are cheesy in a good way. Level designs are also great.

The difficulty curve is too steep in the last area, I must say. But even though it's quite challenging, it's definitely not Katana Zero level maddening. And the final boss is made not to get beaten. I hate it but I had to get used to it overtime...

Definitely a must play.

I’ve put nearly 400 hours into this game, so this definitely isn’t just frustration after a few bad matches. The biggest thing hurting the experience right now is the number of cheaters - there are simply far too many of them. What makes it even more frustrating is that the game keeps getting updates, with new things to grind for or buy and various quality-of-life changes, yet there’s barely any visible progress when it comes to dealing with cheaters. It’s even more disappointing that reports don’t seem to make much of a difference. And this stopped being just a casual match problem a long time ago - ranked is full of cheaters as well, even though fair play should be one of the main priorities there. At some point, it starts to feel like this issue just isn’t getting the level of attention it has deserved for a long time.

Having just 100%'d Guacamelee 2 (on normal), I can tell you without a doubt that it is a masterpiece, and easily my #2 game of the year, only bested by Celeste, and topping God of War among all the others. Drinkbox Studios have made a beautiful, incredibly well written, extremely well designed, and entirely whole experience with Guacamelee 2, and you'd be doing yourself a major disservice if you decided to skip it. I could go on about how satisfying the combat is and how perfectly the platforming scales in difficulty, how fun it is to explore and engage with the world, how often the script had me laughing, etcetera, but then I think about how someone might be reading these words instead of spending that time playing Guacamelee 2, and I realize that it would be a waste. So go play it.

Great game, if your game is stuttering:

1) Go to Nvidia Control Panel
2) Manage 3D Settings
3) Program Settings and add game
4) Turn Low Latency Mode to Ultra
